title: Online Teachers Database
markdown:
American Group International (AGI), USA, is a leading provider of high-quality educational services, dedicated to empowering students and teachers worldwide. With a strong commitment to inclusive education, AGI offers a range of programs tailored to meet the diverse needs of learners, including those with special needs and learning differences. Our online teacher's database is a dynamic platform connecting experienced educators with students across the globe, ensuring access to personalized, top-tier education. Join us in making a difference in education—where every student matters, and every teacher can make an impact. Explore our opportunities today and become part of a global community dedicated to lifelong learning and success. Please contact us at agiangliama@gmail.com if you want to hire our online teachers.

|  | **Professor Asma** | I am a TESOL-certified educator with hands-on classroom experience and a passion for creating inclusive, student-centred learning environments. With a degree in Human Resources and a strong interest in psychology, I bring valuable insight into student motivation and behaviour, enabling me to address both academic and emotional needs effectively.  My experience studying and living abroad has deepened my appreciation for diverse cultures and educational systems, which I draw upon to foster globally minded classrooms where all learners feel valued and engaged. Over the course of my teaching journey, I have developed strong classroom management skills and the ability to adapt lessons to different learning styles, encouraging critical thinking and active participation to build confidence and independence.  Fluent in Arabic, French, and English—with Spanish in progress—I am well-prepared to support multilingual learners and bridge language barriers. I view language as more than a means of communication: it is a gateway to broader opportunities and richer perspectives. | Delivery Online |
